## Summary / 变更说明

Describe the problem, implementation, and user-visible impact. / 请说明问题、实现方式和用户影响。

## Verification / 验证

- [ ] `npm test` 通过
- [ ] `npm run pack:check` 通过
- [ ] Public API changes update runtime types and both documentation languages / 公开 API 已同步类型和双语文档
- [ ] Animation, pointer, weight, image, physics, or lifecycle changes include regression tests / 相关改动包含回归测试
- [ ] English and Simplified Chinese changelogs are synchronized / 中英文版本记录已同步
- [ ] No secrets, logs, archives, or editor state are committed / 未提交密钥、日志、压缩包或编辑器状态

## Compatibility / 兼容性

Explain any effect on UMD, CommonJS, ESM, TypeScript, and browser behavior. / 请说明各入口、类型和浏览器行为是否受影响。
